observation.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
cd /tmp
# Step 1: GET / to obtain session cookie + CSRF token
CSRF=$(curl -s -c /tmp/cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -oE "<meta name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]+\"" | sed "s/.*content=\"//;s/\" *$//")
echo "CSRF: ${CSRF:0:16}... (len ${#CSRF})"
# Step 2: POST /api/v1/signin with documented credentials
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -c /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/login.json -w "POST /api/v1/signin -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" \
  -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-raw "{\"email\":\"admin@example.com\",\"password\":\"test\",\"authenticity_token\":\"${CSRF}\"}"
echo "--- login.json (first 500 chars) ---"
head -c 500 /tmp/login.json; echo
# Step 3: verify authenticated session
curl -s -b /tmp/cj.txt -o /tmp/session.json -w "GET /api/v1/signshow -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signshow
grep -oE "\"email\":\"[^\"]+\"" /tmp/session.json | head -1
' 2>&1
